label: Pyramid
description: Funnel turned upside down (smallest on top) with gaps between the layers and labels beside them; a safety pyramid.
howTo: Bind `series[0].data` to rows `{name, value}`; the chart orders them itself (`sort: "ascending"` puts the smallest on top).
Width is proportional to `value` between `min` and `max`; `minSize` / `maxSize` set the narrowest and widest layer.
Change the label text in `label.formatter` (`{b}` name, `{c}` value, `{d}` percent of the total).

label: Funnel Compare
description: A translucent “expected” funnel behind a narrower “actual” one, with expected labels outside and actual values inside.
howTo: Two series share the same stage names: bind `series[0].data` to the expected values and `series[1].data` to the actual ones, both as `{name, value}` rows.
Both series must use the same `min` / `max` (here 0–100) so their widths are comparable; `sort: "none"` keeps the stage order of the data.
The legend shows the stages, not the two series; the tooltip shows the series name (`{a}`).
